text: 🎬 'Animals' is now Netflix's biggest streaming hit Ben Affleck directs and co-stars in an R-rated, 108-minute thriller that, per /Film, has topped Netflix's streaming numbers. It's a lean, adult genre piece, with no franchise and no multiverse. Kerry Washington follows 'Wake Up Dead Man' with another Netflix win. Two hits in a row make her one of the platform's most dependable faces. Affleck as director-for-hire, delivering tight thrillers at a streamer's pace, suits him better than another capes-and-cowls detour. Mid-budget grown-up movies didn't die. They moved to Netflix. ✈️ Add to watchlist

🎬 Soderbergh takes the Batcowl behind the camera Steven Soderbergh has stepped in to finish shooting 'The Batman Part II', and Matt Reeves plans to return for post-production. The details are thin so far. Soderbergh is a fast, practical shooter who often works as his own cinematographer. That's a useful skill when a big production needs to wrap efficiently. Nothing so far says Robert Pattinson 's return is in doubt. If Reeves keeps the edit, the score and the final look, the film will still read as his Gotham, and Soderbergh will have been a clean-up hitter.
